projectDescription: A supervised machine learning project that uses GANs for synthetic data generation and multiple classifiers (Random Forest, SVM, KNN, Naive Bayes, XGBoost, LightGBM) to detect fraudulent credit card transactions.
keyFeatures: GAN-based synthetic fraud data generation to address class imbalance
Six supervised classifiers: Random Forest, SVM, KNN, Naive Bayes, XGBoost, LightGBM
Comprehensive evaluation with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score
End-to-end Jupyter Notebook workflow on real-world credit card dataset
publicApiSurface: build_generator() — builds the GAN generator model
build_discriminator() — builds the GAN discriminator model
build_gan(generator, discriminator) — combines generator and discriminator into a GAN
generate_synthetic_data(generator, num_samples) — generates synthetic fraud samples
monitor_generator(generator) — evaluates generator output via PCA visualization
